description.zh: 数据库类型，取值请参见[DbType参数说明](~~198106~~)。
description.en: The database engine type. For more information about the valid values, see [DbType parameter](~~198106~~).

description.zh: 数据库的环境类型，更多信息，请参见[实例环境说明](~~163309~~)。
description.en: The environment type of the database. For more information, see [Instance environment description](~~163309~~).
The number of entries per page.

The method for sorting the query results. Valid values:

- **LAST\_ACTIVE\_TIME**: sorts the results by the last active time.

- **DB\_NAME**: sorts the results by the database name.

description.zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字。
description.en: The keyword to search for databases.

description.zh:
权限范围，取值如下：
- **HAS_PERMSSION**：有权限的数据库
- **OWNER**：我Owner的数据库
- **MY_FOCUS**：我关注的数据库
- **UNKNOWN**：不限
description.en:
The permission scope. Valid values:

- **HAS\_PERMSSION**: databases that you have permissions on.

- **OWNER**: databases that you own.

- **MY\_FOCUS**: databases that you follow.

- **UNKNOWN**: all databases.

description.zh:
搜索目标，取值如下：
- **DB**：不限（不区分单库或逻辑库）
- **SINGLE_DB**：单库
- **LOGIC_DB**：逻辑库
description.en:
The search target. Valid values:

- **DB**: all databases, including physical and logical databases.

- **SINGLE\_DB**: physical databases.

- **LOGIC\_DB**: logical databases.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise search-database --tid 3000 --search-key testdb --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --env-type test --search-range HAS_PERMSSION --search-target SINGLE_DB --db-type MYSQL --real-login-user-uid example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise SearchDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --SearchRange HAS_PERMSSION --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SearchKey testdb --SearchTarget SINGLE_DB --RealLoginUserUid 'example-string' --Tid 3000 --EnvType test --DbType MYSQL
